lines.text: David asks the LORD for help because the godly are no more, and people lie to one another.
David asks the LORD to cut off flattering lips, and the boastful say they will prevail with their horses.
The LORD says He will arise for the oppressed and the needy and bring safety to him who yearns.
The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace and bronze purified sevenfold.
David says the LORD will forever guard us, while the wicked wander freely and vileness is exalted among men.
